candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months. Di pikin get cough or e dey find am hard to breathe. E get diarrhoea, and diarrhoea don last 3 days. Blood dey inside stool. For diarrhoea, di pikin dey drink normal, e no dey restless or irritable, skin pinch normal, eye no sink. E get ear problem and e dey feel ear pain, but ear discharge no dey, pus no dey come out from ear, and swelling behind ear no dey. Fever dey, and e don last 2 days. Di fever dey with high malaria risk, malaria test dey and e show positive. Generalized rash dey, and cough with measles dey, but e never get measles for di last 3 months. Mouth ulcer no dey, obvious cause for fever no dey, pus no dey come out from eye, red eye no dey, runny nose no dey, stiff neck no dey, and cornea no dey cloud. Temperature na 38.0°C. For respiratory, breaths count for one minute dey, pikin calm, chest no dey indraw, cough don last 3 days, pulse oximeter no dey, recurrent wheeze no dey, respiratory rate na 42, stridor no dey when calm, and wheezing no dey. Di pikin no dey convulse now, e never convulse before, e no lethargic or unconscious, e able to drink or breastfeed, and e no dey vomit everything. No identified bacterial cause for fever.
